mapper.select: WITH ranked_articles AS ( SELECT n1.id AS passageId, n1.title AS title, n1.`partition` AS labelId, n2.name AS labelName, n1.create_time AS createTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY n1.`partition` ORDER BY n1.create_time DESC ) AS article_rank FROM tbl_passage AS n1 LEFT JOIN tbl_passage_partition AS n2 ON n1.`partition` = n2.id ) SELECT passageId, title, labelId, labelName, createTime FROM ranked_articles WHERE article_rank <= 10

select n1.id as passageId, n1.title as title, n1.author_id as authorId, n1.create_time as createTime, n1.update_time as updateTime, n1.author_name as authorName, n1.likes as likes, n1.collection as collection, n1.views as views, n1.images as images, n1.`partition` as partitionId, n1.is_check as isCheck, n1.fake_rate as fakeRate, n1.status as status, n1.comment_counts, n2.name as partitionName from tbl_passage as n1 left join tbl_passage_partition as n2 on n1.`partition` = n2.id where n1.id = #{passageId}
